verdict.rationale: Finix is a payments-infrastructure platform with a dashboard, SDKs and APIs. Asking whether users can opt out of telemetry or usage tracking is fair for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has nothing on telemetry, analytics or tracking controls: notification settings and webhooks are a different feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
